ArtifactRefV1.description:
A reference to a stored artifact — never the raw bytes themselves.

Stages pass around pointers (path + hash + mime type). The actual file
lives in the object store (S3-compatible); the manifest / envelope only
ever stores the reference.

path.description: Content-addressed storage path/key for the artifact, e.g. 's3://bucket/artifacts/<sha256>.mp4'. Must not be a mutable alias such as 'latest.mp4'.
path.title: Path

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact contents.
hash.title: Hash

mime_type.description: MIME type of the stored artifact, e.g. 'video/mp4', 'audio/wav', 'application/json'.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this artifact reference was created.
created_at.title: Created At

ProviderDescriptorV1.description:
Generic description of whatever implementation handled a stage.

The pipeline graph never knows concrete vendor names — it only knows
capabilities (e.g. "voice_provider"). This descriptor is where the
concrete provider identity is recorded, for telemetry/debugging, without
leaking that identity into the graph or contracts.

model.description: Underlying model name used by the provider implementation.
model.title: Model

version.description: Version/tag of the model or provider implementation.
version.title: Version

capability.description: The abstract capability this provider fulfills, e.g. 'script_generation', 'voice_synthesis', 'avatar_render'.
capability.title: Capability

endpoint.description: Provider API endpoint or resource identifier, if applicable
endpoint.title: Endpoint

cost.description: Cost incurred for this stage execution, if known
cost.title: Cost

latency_ms.description: Execution latency in milliseconds, if known
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

timestamp.description: When this provider was invoked, if known
timestamp.title: Timestamp

ProviderDescriptorV1.title: ProviderDescriptorV1

description:
The wrapper every pipeline stage receives and emits.

Required fields per the runbook:
    - stage_id
    - attempt
    - input hash
    - artifact references
    - validation reference
    - provider descriptor

stage_id.description: Permanent identifier for the stage/gate, e.g. 'S00', 'S10', ..., 'G80', 'G90', 'S100'.
stage_id.title: Stage Id

attempt.description: 1-indexed attempt number for this stage execution. Distinguishes a first run from a local retry.
attempt.title: Attempt

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of this stage's input payload. Changes whenever the upstream input changes.
input_hash.title: Input Hash

artifact_refs.description: References to artifacts produced/consumed by this stage. Never raw bytes.
artifact_refs.title: Artifact Refs

validation_ref.description: Reference to this stage's ValidationReportV1 artifact (e.g. a stored validation_report.json), not the report inline.

provider.description: Descriptor of whichever provider implementation executed this stage, keyed by capability rather than vendor name.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this envelope was created.
created_at.title: Created At

title: StageEnvelopeV1
